answer: Stop sybils with a hardware-anchored identity ledger. First, each agent registers one enclave, which signs a unique vertex in the trust graph; a second registration from the same chip is rejected. Second, it enters through one inlet and passes a 48-hour live check by peers. Third, its reputation stands on a knoll: honest jobs raise it, while one forgery slashes its 300-token bond and freezes the enclave 90 days. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 chips, burns 3,000,000 tokens, and wastes 480,000 hours. Like a lighthouse, one true light earns trust; painted copies cast no beam.
